decisionScope: Exact five-module source change and candidate images are suitable for the planned existing core/worker image update. This is not installed behavior or successful native reuse.

checks.finding: background_model_time_limit first checks exact ContextVar-bound source identity. The runner callback calls its existing authorize guard, rechecking cancellation, immutable effective deadline and durable store authority before returning positive remaining seconds. Invalid/zero/nonfinite time is rejected.

Runner reuses the existing min(spec.deadline, start plus original grant duration). It neither changes grant limits nor creates a new retry, work, claim or deadline. Each model phase captures one monotonic deadline; internal transport retries consume that same phase time.

The SDK receives the remaining duration of that captured phase deadline; outer asyncio.timeout uses its current remaining duration. SDK credential/setup delay cannot extend the outer phase. A positive SDK floor cannot extend the outer zero-time expiry.

Both ordinary generation and language repair supply the same live host callback. A subsequent phase reads time remaining against the existing task deadline, so earlier model/tool/repair time is already spent. Input preparation after phase capture is also deducted from the outer allowance.

Existing 50ms task watcher, run_cancellable, exact source ingress check, durable dispatch guard and final authorize remain. Source mismatch fails before allowance use; expired/owner-stop paths do not permit tools, and local owned stream closure is checked by the model-free runner transport tests.

The durable output-budget guard still rejects partial/unknown prior usage; existing failed-request journaling and replay prohibition remain unchanged. No automatic continuation of the closed failed native case is introduced.

PydanticConversationModel constructor still restricts configured foreground-style duration to1..120 seconds. Shared provider now accepts only positive finite host durations; only trusted callers supply these values. Existing other provider caller constant/settings behavior is unchanged.
Host time callback stays in application scope and runner composition; adapter only consumes a duration. No user/model-set deadline field, capability, role, store or instruction-authority change.

regressionEvidence.coverage: Invalid/source-mismatched duration, dynamic remaining balance, SDK/outer duration equality within elapsed setup, longer300s/shorter20s/legacy30s bounds, owner stop and already expired admission, source/authority guards, preserved UNKNOWN no internal retry; existing language/continuation/provider/composition checks.
regressionEvidence.qualification: Receipt binds the exact source hashes and completed exec output; no fresh test or native probe performed by the reviewer.
